description: Split text into retrieval-ready chunks for RAG and embeddings: recursive (paragraph > line > sentence > clause > word), markdown-aware (splits on headings, keeps the heading path per chunk, respects code fences), sentence, or fixed windows; sized in estimated tokens or characters with overlap. Returns each chunk with Unicode start/end offsets, character and token estimates, plus totals. Deterministic and offline; 200 KB input. Price: $0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/text-chunk

chunk_size.description: Max chunk size in the unit (tokens 16-8192, default 512; chars 64-32768, default 2000)

include_text.description: Return chunk text (default true); false returns offsets only

overlap.description: Overlap between consecutive chunks, at most half of chunk_size (default 10%)

text.description: Text or Markdown to chunk (max 200 KB)

name: text_chunk
title: Text Chunk
